mapper.sql: fnd32_account_id AS account_id, fnd32_setup_date AS setup_date, fnd32_corp_id AS corp_id, f_get_corp_nm(fnd32_corp_id) AS corp_name, fnd32_branch AS branch, fnd32_account_cd1 AS account_code1, f_cdnm('Fnd32Code1', fnd32_account_cd1, fnd32_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS account_name1, fnd32_account_cd2 AS account_code2, f_cdnm('Fnd32Code2', fnd32_account_cd2, fnd32_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS account_name2, fnd32_account_nm AS account_name, to_decrypts(fnd32_account_no) AS dec_account_no, fnd32_bank_corp_id AS bank_corp_id, f_get_corp_nm(fnd32_bank_corp_id) AS bank_corp_name, to_decrypts(fnd32_bank_link_no) AS dec_bank_link_no, fnd32_account_state_cd AS account_state_code, f_cdnm('AccountStateCode', fnd32_account_state_cd, fnd32_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS account_state_name, fnd32_ipo_out_cd AS ipo_out_code, f_cdnm('IpoOutCode', fnd32_ipo_out_cd, fnd32_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS ipo_out_name, fnd32_manager_tel AS manager_tel, fnd32_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fnd32_account WHERE 1=1 AND fnd32_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd32_account_state_cd LIKE #{accountStateCode} AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_get_corp_nm(fnd32_corp_id) ,f_cdnm('Fnd32Code1',fnd32_account_cd1,fnd32_company_id,f_sysdate()) ,f_cdnm('Fnd32Code2',fnd32_account_cd2,fnd32_company_id,f_sysdate()) ,to_decrypts(fnd32_account_no) ,to_decrypts(fnd32_bank_link_no) ,fnd32_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY fnd32_setup_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd32_account ( fnd32_account_id, fnd32_company_id, fnd32_setup_date, fnd32_corp_id, fnd32_branch, fnd32_account_cd1, fnd32_account_cd2 , fnd32_account_nm, fnd32_account_no, fnd32_bank_corp_id, fnd32_bank_link_no, fnd32_account_state_cd, fnd32_ipo_out_cd , fnd32_manager_tel, fnd32_note ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{companyId}, #{r.setupDate}, #{r.corpId}, #{r.branch}, #{r.accountCode1}, #{r.accountCode2} , #{r.accountName}, to_encrypts(#{r.decAccountNo}), #{r.bankCorpId}, to_encrypts(#{r.decBankLinkNo}), #{r.accountStateCode}, #{r.ipoOutCode} , #{r.managerTel}, #{r.note} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fnd32_account SET fnd32_setup_date = #{r.setupDate}, fnd32_corp_id = #{r.corpId}, fnd32_branch = #{r.branch}, fnd32_account_cd1 = #{r.accountCode1}, fnd32_account_cd2 = #{r.accountCode2}, fnd32_account_nm = #{r.accountName}, fnd32_account_no = to_encrypts(#{r.decAccountNo}), fnd32_bank_corp_id = #{r.bankCorpId}, fnd32_bank_link_no = to_encrypts(#{r.decBankLinkNo}), fnd32_account_state_cd = #{r.accountStateCode}, fnd32_ipo_out_cd = #{r.ipoOutCode}, fnd32_manager_tel = #{r.managerTel}, fnd32_note = #{r.note} WHERE fnd32_account_id = #{r.accountId} AND fnd32_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT sys09_code FROM sys09_code c , sys08_code_kind k WHERE sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id AND ( ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_company_id = 0 ) OR ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') != 'true' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} ) ) AND sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCode} AND sys09_name = #{name} AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' AND sys09_apply_date <= #{applyDate} ORDER BY sys09_seq LIMIT 1
